strings.en: Th1 = cellular immunity (defence against infection), Th2 = allergy / atopic dermatitis, Th17 = psoriasis / HS / PsA

strings.en: oral JAK inhibitor for alopecia areata

≥ 80% BSA 紅斑 + Sézary 細胞 ≥ 1000/μL

用法說明：本字典為衛教輔助工具。詞彙解釋以本站常用程度與病人實際遇到的情境設計、完整定義請參考各文章 / 學會共識。發現錯誤或希望新增詞彙、請寫信告知。
量表
PASI 75 / 90 / 100
PASI improvement endpoints
乾癬治療成效指標。PASI 75 ＝ 治療 16 週皮膚改善 ≥ 75%、PASI 90 ≥ 90%、PASI 100 ＝ 完全清除。傳統治療目標 PASI 50-75、現代生物製劑提升至 PASI 90/100。
乾癬全身性治療 →
量表
EASI / IGA
Eczema Area and Severity Index / Investigator Global Assessment
異位性皮膚炎嚴重度（EASI 0-72；IGA 0-4）。EASI 75/90 = 改善 ≥ 75%/90%。台灣健保 dupilumab 給付門檻：EASI ≥ 24、IGA ≥ 4。
AD 全身性治療 →
藥物
Dupilumab（杜避炎®）
anti-IL-4Rα monoclonal antibody
2017 年首支 FDA 核准的異位性皮膚炎生物製劑、阻斷 IL-4 / IL-13 訊號。每 2 週皮下注射、≥ 6 月嬰兒適用。台灣健保有給付（EASI ≥ 24 + IGA ≥ 4）。
Dupilumab 介紹 →
藥物
JAK 抑制劑
Janus kinase inhibitors
口服標靶藥、阻斷 JAK1/2/3 訊號。AD 用 abrocitinib（希必皮）、upadacitinib（銳虎），EASI 75 達 60-78%。FDA 黑框警告：MACE、靜脈血栓、惡性腫瘤風險、≥ 65 歲避用。
JAK 抑制劑 →
藥物
IL-23 抑制劑
IL-23 inhibitors
最新一代乾癬生物製劑。Risankizumab（喜瑞莎）、guselkumab（創癬寧）、tildrakizumab（聖癬寧）。每 8-12 週皮下注射、感染風險最低、合併 IBD 可用。
IL-23 抑制劑 →
藥物
IL-17 抑制劑
IL-17 inhibitors
第二代乾癬生物製劑。Secukinumab（可在新）、ixekizumab（達癬美）、bimekizumab（碧美時）。對指甲、頭皮、PsA 效果好。合併 IBD 禁用。
IL-17 抑制劑 →
處置
皮膚切片
skin biopsy (shave / punch / incisional / excisional)
皮膚科診斷的關鍵工具。4 種技術：削皮（shave）淺、環鋸（punch）4 mm 全層、切口（incisional）取大病灶部分、切除（excisional）含邊緣完整切下。
4 種切片技術 →
處置
梭形切除（Fusiform Excision）
fusiform / elliptical excision
皮膚腫瘤切除標準術式。3：1 長寬比、頂角 ≤ 30°、長軸平行 Langer 線（皮膚張力線）以降低疤痕張力。
梭形切除流程 →
疾病
乾癬性關節炎（PsA）
Psoriatic arthritis
15-30% 乾癬病人合併。皮膚通常先發病 5-10 年。5 大警訊：晨僵 > 30 分鐘、臘腸指、肌腱附著點炎、發炎性背痛、DIP 關節炎。陽性 → 風濕科 + 直接生物製劑。
PsA 合併症 →
strings.en: How to read this: This glossary is a patient-education aid. Entries are written around how often a term comes up on this site and the situations patients actually meet, so for a complete definition see the individual articles or the relevant society consensus. If you spot an error, or would like a term added, please email us.

strings.zh: 首頁/醫學詞彙白話翻譯
strings.en: Home/Dermatology terms in plain English

strings.zh: 量表機轉藥物分型檢查 / 處置症狀
陳翊嘉醫師 · 皮膚科衛教筆記

皮膚科醫學詞彙
白話翻譯字典
看懂自己的病歷、診斷單、衛教文章。本字典依「量表 / 機轉 / 藥物 / 疾病分型 / 檢查」分類、每個專業詞附最白話的解釋與對應衛教文章連結。
strings.en: Make sense of your chart, your diagnosis slip and the articles here. Terms are grouped by "scales / mechanisms / drugs / disease subtypes / investigations", each with a plain-language explanation and a link to the relevant article.

strings.zh: 1 · 臨床量表 / 評估工具
異位性皮膚炎嚴重度評分。面積 + 客觀症狀（紅、腫、滲、抓痕、苔癬化、乾）+ 主觀症狀（癢、失眠）三大項組合，0-103 分。<25 輕、25-50 中、>50 重。
strings.en: Atopic dermatitis severity score. Combines area + objective signs (erythema, oedema, oozing, excoriation, lichenification, dryness) + subjective symptoms (itch, sleep loss), 0-103. <25 mild, 25-50 moderate, >50 severe.

strings.zh: 乾癬嚴重度。頭頸 / 上肢 / 軀幹 / 下肢四區紅斑 + 浸潤 + 鱗屑 + 面積加權，0-72。健保生物製劑申請門檻 PASI ≥ 10。
strings.en: Psoriasis severity. Head/neck, upper limbs, trunk and lower limbs scored for erythema + induration + scaling + area, weighted, 0-72. Taiwan NHI biologic threshold is PASI ≥ 10.

strings.zh: 皮膚病生活品質量表,10 題自評，0-30 分。生物製劑健保申請常見門檻 DLQI ≥ 10。
strings.en: Dermatology Life Quality Index, 10 self-rated items, 0-30. A common NHI biologic threshold is DLQI ≥ 10.

strings.zh: 蕁麻疹活動度。每天「風團數」+「癢感」各 0-3，連續 7 天加總，0-42。控制目標 ≤ 6。
strings.en: Urticaria activity. Daily wheal count and itch, each 0-3, summed over 7 consecutive days, 0-42. Target is ≤ 6.

strings.zh: 蕁麻疹控制測試，4 題快速評估。16 = 完全控制、12-15 = 部分控制、< 12 = 控制不佳。
strings.en: Urticaria Control Test, 4 quick items. 16 = complete control, 12-15 = partial control, < 12 = poorly controlled.

strings.zh: 圓禿頭皮禿髮百分比。頂(40%)+ 後(24%)+ 左(18%)+ 右(18%)。SALT ≥ 50 為重度，JAK 抑制劑適應症。
strings.en: Percentage of scalp hair lost in alopecia areata. Vertex (40%) + occiput (24%) + left (18%) + right (18%). SALT ≥ 50 is severe and an indication for JAK inhibitors.

strings.zh: 痘痘嚴重度全球分級。6 部位 × 病灶嚴重度權重總和，0-44。≥ 31 為重度，Isotretinoin 適應症。
strings.en: Global Acne Grading System. Six sites × lesion-severity weights, 0-44. ≥ 31 is severe and an indication for isotretinoin.

strings.zh: 肝斑嚴重度。前額 + 兩頰 + 下巴 4 區的面積 × （深淺 + 同質性）加權，0-48。
strings.en: Melasma severity. Forehead, both cheeks and chin scored as area × (darkness + homogeneity), weighted, 0-48.

strings.zh: 化膿性汗腺炎(HS)I 期 / II 期 / III 期分級。II 期以上為 Adalimumab 健保適應症參考。
strings.en: Hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) graded stage I / II / III. Stage II and above is the reference point for adalimumab under Taiwan NHI.

strings.zh: 男性 Norwood I-VII / 女性 Ludwig I-III 雄性禿分級。越嚴重需越積極治療(Finasteride、植髮）。
strings.en: Androgenetic alopecia graded Norwood I-VII in men, Ludwig I-III in women. The more advanced, the more aggressive the treatment (finasteride, hair transplant).

strings.zh: 膚色分型 I-VI。亞洲人多為 III-IV 型，雷射 / 化學換膚易反黑(PIH)，需嚴格防曬。
strings.en: Skin phototypes I-VI. Most Asians are type III-IV, prone to post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation after laser or chemical peels, so strict photoprotection matters.

strings.zh: 異膚另一常用評估，SCORAD 替代品。EASI 75 / 90 / 100 表示改善 ≥75% / 90% / 100%。
strings.en: The other widely used AD measure, an alternative to SCORAD. EASI 75 / 90 / 100 mean ≥75% / 90% / 100% improvement.

strings.zh: 結節性癢疹整體評估。0-4,0 = 清除、1 = 接近清除（治療目標）。
strings.en: Investigator Global Assessment for prurigo nodularis, 0-4. 0 = clear, 1 = almost clear (the treatment target).

strings.zh: 過去 24 小時最強搔癢 0-10 分。≥ 4 分降幅為臨床顯著反應。
strings.en: Worst itch in the past 24 hours, 0-10. A drop of ≥ 4 points is a clinically meaningful response.

strings.zh: 白斑活動度評估。VIDA ≥ +2 為活動性，需口服治療壓制；VIDA ≤ 0 ≥ 1 年為穩定可手術。
strings.en: Vitiligo disease activity. VIDA ≥ +2 means active disease needing systemic suppression; VIDA ≤ 0 for ≥ 1 year means stable and suitable for surgery.

strings.zh: 皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤(MF/SS)分期。T（皮膚）+ N（淋巴結）+ M（內臟）+ B（血液）。B2 ≥ 1000/μL 自動為 SS。
strings.en: Staging for cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (MF/SS). T (skin) + N (nodes) + M (viscera) + B (blood). B2 ≥ 1000/μL is automatically Sézary syndrome.

strings.zh: 異位性皮膚炎、過敏性氣喘、CRSwNP 的核心發炎細胞激素。Dupilumab 阻斷 IL-4Rα，同時關掉 IL-4 + IL-13 訊號。
strings.en: The core inflammatory cytokines of atopic dermatitis, allergic asthma and CRSwNP. Dupilumab blocks IL-4Rα, switching off IL-4 and IL-13 signalling together.

strings.zh: 乾癬、乾癬性關節炎、化膿性汗腺炎的主要驅動細胞激素。Secukinumab / Bimekizumab 抗 IL-17;Risankizumab / Guselkumab 抗 IL-23。
strings.en: The main drivers of psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis and hidradenitis suppurativa. Secukinumab / bimekizumab target IL-17; risankizumab / guselkumab target IL-23.

strings.zh: 「搔癢細胞激素」。在結節性癢疹、異膚高度活化。Nemolizumab 抗 IL-31R 後癢感 1-2 週內顯著改善。
strings.en: The "itch cytokine". Highly active in prurigo nodularis and atopic dermatitis. Blocking IL-31R with nemolizumab improves itch markedly within 1-2 weeks.

strings.zh: 細胞激素受體下游細胞內訊號傳遞路徑。JAK1-3 + TYK2。JAK 抑制劑(Baricitinib、Upadacitinib、Abrocitinib、Ritlecitinib)阻斷此路徑。
strings.en: The intracellular signalling pathway downstream of cytokine receptors. JAK1-3 + TYK2. JAK inhibitors (baricitinib, upadacitinib, abrocitinib, ritlecitinib) block it.

strings.zh: 慢性發炎主軸細胞激素。Adalimumab、Etanercept、Infliximab、Certolizumab 為 TNF-α 抑制劑、用於乾癬、HS、PsA、IBD。
strings.en: A central cytokine of chronic inflammation. Adalimumab, etanercept, infliximab and certolizumab are TNF-α inhibitors, used in psoriasis, HS, PsA and IBD.

strings.zh: 發炎後色素沉著(PIH，棕黑）或紅斑(PIE，紅）。亞洲人 PIH 風險高、雷射 / 痘痘後常見。
strings.en: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH, brown-black) or erythema (PIE, red). PIH risk is high in Asian skin and common after laser or acne.

strings.zh: 受傷 / 摩擦 / 抓癢處誘發新病灶。常見於白斑、乾癬、扁平苔癬。手術前白斑必須穩定 1 年才適合移植。
strings.en: New lesions appear at sites of injury, friction or scratching. Typical of vitiligo, psoriasis and lichen planus. Vitiligo must be stable for a year before grafting is appropriate.

strings.zh: 輔助 T 細胞分支：Th1 = 細胞免疫（感染防禦）、Th2 = 過敏 / 異膚、Th17 = 乾癬 / HS / PsA。
strings.en: Helper T-cell subsets: Th1 = cellular immunity (defence against infection), Th2 = allergy / atopic dermatitis, Th17 = psoriasis / HS / PsA.

strings.zh: Dupilumab（度普利尤單抗 / 杜避炎）
第一個皮膚科廣譜生物製劑。FDA 適應症：異膚 ≥ 6 個月、結節性癢疹、氣喘、CRSwNP、嗜酸性食道炎。每 2 週 1 針。
strings.en: The first broad-spectrum biologic in dermatology. FDA indications: atopic dermatitis from 6 months of age, prurigo nodularis, asthma, CRSwNP, eosinophilic oesophagitis. One injection every 2 weeks.

strings.zh: 2024 FDA 核准的結節性癢疹專用生物製劑。每 4 週 1 針（優勢：比 dupilumab 少注射）。
strings.en: The 2024 FDA-approved biologic specifically for prurigo nodularis. One injection every 4 weeks (fewer injections than dupilumab).

strings.zh: 慢性自發性蕁麻疹(CSU)第二線。300 mg q4w，反應不佳可加量至 600 mg q2w(off-label)。
strings.en: Second line for chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU). 300 mg q4w, and if the response is poor it can be escalated to 600 mg q2w (off-label).

strings.zh: 第一個 FDA / EMA 核准的圓禿口服 JAK 抑制劑（成人重度）；亦用於異膚、類風濕。
strings.en: The first FDA/EMA-approved oral JAK inhibitor for alopecia areata (severe disease in adults); also used in atopic dermatitis and rheumatoid arthritis.

strings.zh: ≥ 12 歲圓禿適應症。200 mg/day × 4 週 loading → 50 mg/day 維持。
strings.en: Indicated for alopecia areata from age 12. 200 mg/day for 4 weeks as loading, then 50 mg/day maintenance.

strings.zh: 乾癬 / PsA / 克隆氏症生物製劑。每 12 週 1 針（優勢：注射間隔長）。台灣健保有條件給付。
strings.en: A biologic for psoriasis, PsA and Crohn's disease. One injection every 12 weeks — the longest dosing interval of the class. Conditionally covered by Taiwan NHI.

strings.zh: 雙重 IL-17 抑制(A + F)。乾癬 PASI 100 達成率最高的生物製劑(60%+ 16w)。
strings.en: Dual IL-17 inhibition (A + F). The biologic with the highest PASI 100 rate in psoriasis (over 60% at 16 weeks).

strings.zh: 第一個選擇性 TYK2 抑制劑口服乾癬藥。較傳統 JAK1-3 安全性更好（無 ORAL Surveillance 警示）。
strings.en: The first selective TYK2 inhibitor taken orally for psoriasis. A better safety profile than classic JAK1-3 inhibitors, with no ORAL Surveillance warning.

strings.zh: CD30+ 皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤(MF / pcALCL)。ALCANZA 試驗：ORR4 56% vs 13%。
strings.en: For CD30+ cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (MF / pcALCL). ALCANZA trial: ORR4 56% vs 13%.

strings.zh: Sézary syndrome / 進展期 MF。MAVORIC 試驗中位 PFS 7.7 vs 3.1 月。
strings.en: Sézary syndrome and advanced MF. MAVORIC trial: median PFS 7.7 vs 3.1 months.

strings.zh: 2022 FDA 核准的白斑外用藥(≥ 12 歲、NSV、≤ 10% 體表）。52 週 50% 達 F-VASI 75。
strings.en: The 2022 FDA-approved topical for vitiligo (age ≥ 12, non-segmental, ≤ 10% body surface). Half of patients reached F-VASI 75 by 52 weeks.

strings.zh: 2020 FDA 核准的外用抗雄激素痘痘藥。40 年來第一個新機轉外用痘痘藥。
strings.en: The 2020 FDA-approved topical antiandrogen for acne — the first topical acne drug with a new mechanism in 40 years.

strings.zh: ≤ 5 mg/day 不影響血壓劑量。女性 1.25-2.5 mg、男性 2.5-5 mg(Olsen 2025 JAAD 共識）。
strings.en: Doses of ≤ 5 mg/day, below the blood-pressure-lowering range. Women 1.25-2.5 mg, men 2.5-5 mg (Olsen 2025 JAAD consensus).

strings.zh: 皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤主要型（占 75%)。斑塊期(patch)→ 厚斑期(plaque)→ 結節期(tumor)三階段。
strings.en: The commonest cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, about 75% of cases. Three stages: patch → plaque → tumour.

strings.zh: MF 紅皮症 + 血液 T 細胞侵犯。≥ 80% BSA 紅斑 + Sézary 細胞 ≥ 1000/μL。預後較差。
strings.en: MF with erythroderma plus blood involvement by T cells. ≥ 80% BSA erythema + Sézary cells ≥ 1000/μL. Prognosis is poorer.

strings.zh: 慢性自發性蕁麻疹（風團 ≥ 6 週、無外因）。50% 在 1 年內、80% 在 5 年內自然緩解。
strings.en: Chronic spontaneous urticaria (wheals for ≥ 6 weeks with no external trigger). Half remit spontaneously within a year, 80% within five.

strings.zh: 白斑分節型(SV)vs 非分節型(NSV)。SV 預後較好、適合手術;NSV 對 ruxolitinib 反應好。
strings.en: Segmental (SV) versus non-segmental (NSV) vitiligo. SV has the better prognosis and suits surgery; NSV responds well to ruxolitinib.

strings.zh: 表現型分類（取代舊亞型 I-IV):持續性紅斑、丘疹膿皰、毛細血管擴張、鼻贅。眼部酒糟為合併症。
strings.en: Phenotype-based classification, replacing the old subtypes I-IV: persistent erythema, papules and pustules, telangiectasia, phyma. Ocular rosacea is a comorbidity.

strings.zh: 皮膚切片 + 免疫組織化學
疑似 CTCL / 大皰病 / 紅斑性狼瘡。常用 IHC 標記：CD3/CD4/CD8/CD30/CD20。
strings.en: For suspected CTCL, bullous disease or lupus erythematosus. Common IHC markers: CD3/CD4/CD8/CD30/CD20.

strings.zh: 皮膚切片送檢驗 T 細胞單株性(monoclonality)。MF 早期診斷必備。
strings.en: Testing a skin biopsy for T-cell monoclonality. Essential to diagnosing MF early.

strings.zh: Wood 燈：無創照射、白斑變更亮、Tinea versicolor 黃綠螢光。皮膚鏡：10× 放大鏡輔助痣 / 黑色素瘤 / 圓禿診斷。
strings.en: Wood's lamp: non-invasive illumination; vitiligo appears brighter, tinea versicolor fluoresces yellow-green. Dermoscopy: 10× magnification to help diagnose naevi, melanoma and alopecia areata.

strings.zh: 311-312 nm 窄波。乾癬、白斑、結節性癢疹、廣泛異膚的標準光療。每週 2-3 次。
strings.en: Narrowband 311-312 nm. The standard phototherapy for psoriasis, vitiligo, prurigo nodularis and widespread atopic dermatitis. Two to three sessions a week.

strings.zh: 局限性白斑、乾癬、頑固異膚的精準光療。比 NB-UVB 劑量高、療程短。
strings.en: Targeted phototherapy for localised vitiligo, psoriasis and stubborn atopic dermatitis. Higher dose than NB-UVB over a shorter course.

strings.zh: 最常用 Triamcinolone acetonide(TA)5-10 mg/mL。圓禿、肥厚疤、痘痘結節標準處置。每 4-6 週 1 次。
strings.en: Usually triamcinolone acetonide (TA) 5-10 mg/mL. The standard procedure for alopecia areata, hypertrophic scars and acne nodules. Every 4-6 weeks.

strings.zh: 慢性反覆抓癢導致皮膚增厚、皺紋加深、紋路明顯。常見於異膚、結節性癢疹、神經性皮膚炎。
strings.en: Chronic, repeated scratching thickens the skin, deepening the creases and making skin markings prominent. Typical of atopic dermatitis, prurigo nodularis and neurodermatitis.

strings.zh: 皮膚內含液體的隆起病灶。< 0.5 cm = vesicle、≥ 0.5 cm = bulla。常見於汗皰疹、單純皰疹、水痘、自體免疫大皰病。
strings.en: A raised, fluid-filled lesion. < 0.5 cm = vesicle, ≥ 0.5 cm = bulla. Seen in dyshidrotic eczema, herpes simplex, chickenpox and autoimmune bullous disease.

strings.zh: 內含膿液（白色 / 黃色）的隆起病灶。常見於丘疹膿皰型酒糟、痘痘、毛囊炎。
strings.en: A raised lesion containing pus (white or yellow). Seen in papulopustular rosacea, acne and folliculitis.

strings.zh: 背部上中央出現「三角形未受波及區」（因手抓不到）。結節性癢疹、慢性癢疹特徵。
strings.en: A spared triangle in the upper mid-back, where the hands cannot reach. Characteristic of prurigo nodularis and chronic prurigo.

strings.zh: 皮下深層腫脹、常見於眼瞼、嘴唇、手腳。40% 慢性蕁麻疹病人合併。喉頭水腫為急症。
strings.en: Deep subcutaneous swelling, typically of the eyelids, lips, hands and feet. Around 40% of chronic urticaria patients have it. Laryngeal oedema is an emergency.

strings.zh: 臉部廣泛浸潤性紅斑與皮膚增厚、呈「獅子臉」外觀。可見於 MF 結節期、痲瘋病、淋巴瘤。
strings.en: Widespread infiltrative erythema and thickening of the face, giving a "lion-like" appearance. Seen in tumour-stage MF, leprosy and lymphoma.

strings.zh: 白斑活動性指標。Trichrome：中央白 → 過渡色 → 正常;Confetti：融合性小白點。預示快速進展。
strings.en: Markers of vitiligo activity. Trichrome: white centre → intermediate shade → normal skin; confetti: coalescing small white macules. Both predict rapid progression.

strings.zh: 乾癬治療成效指標。PASI 75 ＝ 治療 16 週皮膚改善 ≥ 75%、PASI 90 ≥ 90%、PASI 100 ＝ 完全清除。傳統治療目標 PASI 50-75、現代生物製劑提升至 PASI 90/100。
strings.en: Psoriasis outcome measures. PASI 75 = at least 75% skin improvement at 16 weeks, PASI 90 ≥ 90%, PASI 100 = complete clearance. The old target was PASI 50-75; modern biologics have raised it to PASI 90/100.

strings.zh: 異位性皮膚炎嚴重度（EASI 0-72；IGA 0-4）。EASI 75/90 = 改善 ≥ 75%/90%。台灣健保 dupilumab 給付門檻：EASI ≥ 24、IGA ≥ 4。
strings.en: Atopic dermatitis severity (EASI 0-72; IGA 0-4). EASI 75/90 = ≥ 75%/90% improvement. Taiwan NHI threshold for dupilumab: EASI ≥ 24 and IGA ≥ 4.

strings.zh: 2017 年首支 FDA 核准的異位性皮膚炎生物製劑、阻斷 IL-4 / IL-13 訊號。每 2 週皮下注射、≥ 6 月嬰兒適用。台灣健保有給付（EASI ≥ 24 + IGA ≥ 4）。
strings.en: The first FDA-approved biologic for atopic dermatitis, approved in 2017, blocking IL-4 and IL-13 signalling. Subcutaneous injection every 2 weeks, licensed from 6 months of age. Covered by Taiwan NHI at EASI ≥ 24 and IGA ≥ 4.

strings.zh: 口服標靶藥、阻斷 JAK1/2/3 訊號。AD 用 abrocitinib（希必皮）、upadacitinib（銳虎），EASI 75 達 60-78%。FDA 黑框警告：MACE、靜脈血栓、惡性腫瘤風險、≥ 65 歲避用。
strings.en: Oral targeted drugs blocking JAK1/2/3 signalling. For AD: abrocitinib and upadacitinib, reaching EASI 75 in 60-78%. FDA boxed warning: MACE, venous thromboembolism and malignancy; avoid from age 65.

strings.zh: 最新一代乾癬生物製劑。Risankizumab（喜瑞莎）、guselkumab（創癬寧）、tildrakizumab（聖癬寧）。每 8-12 週皮下注射、感染風險最低、合併 IBD 可用。
strings.en: The newest generation of psoriasis biologics: risankizumab, guselkumab, tildrakizumab. Subcutaneous every 8-12 weeks, the lowest infection risk of the classes, and usable alongside IBD.

strings.zh: 第二代乾癬生物製劑。Secukinumab（可在新）、ixekizumab（達癬美）、bimekizumab（碧美時）。對指甲、頭皮、PsA 效果好。合併 IBD 禁用。
strings.en: The second generation of psoriasis biologics: secukinumab, ixekizumab, bimekizumab. Strong on nails, scalp and PsA. Contraindicated with IBD.

strings.zh: 皮膚科診斷的關鍵工具。4 種技術：削皮（shave）淺、環鋸（punch）4 mm 全層、切口（incisional）取大病灶部分、切除（excisional）含邊緣完整切下。
strings.en: The key diagnostic tool in dermatology. Four techniques: shave (superficial), punch (4 mm, full thickness), incisional (part of a large lesion) and excisional (the whole lesion with a margin).

strings.zh: 皮膚腫瘤切除標準術式。3：1 長寬比、頂角 ≤ 30°、長軸平行 Langer 線（皮膚張力線）以降低疤痕張力。
strings.en: The standard operation for excising a skin tumour. A 3:1 length-to-width ratio, apical angles ≤ 30°, long axis parallel to Langer's lines, so the scar sits under less tension.

strings.zh: 15-30% 乾癬病人合併。皮膚通常先發病 5-10 年。5 大警訊：晨僵 > 30 分鐘、臘腸指、肌腱附著點炎、發炎性背痛、DIP 關節炎。陽性 → 風濕科 + 直接生物製劑。
strings.en: Affects 15-30% of psoriasis patients, with skin disease usually preceding it by 5-10 years. Five red flags: morning stiffness > 30 minutes, dactylitis, enthesitis, inflammatory back pain, DIP arthritis. If positive → rheumatology, and biologics directly.

strings.zh: 從診間到日常、好好照顧你的皮膚。
strings.en: From the clinic to your everyday skin.
